verdict.rationale: ClickUp explicitly lists 'Sprints' as a first-party feature and offers Jira migration that preserves 'sprints and epics,' plus dev-tool integrations (GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket, Sentry) for tracking progress against tasks, supporting agile engineering workflows. However, the evidence pack gives no detail on sprint mechanics (backlog, velocity, burndown/burnup charts, sprint points) beyond the single word 'Sprints,' and community feedback raises general concerns about ClickUp's engineering/performance quality (though not specifically about sprint planning failing). Missing for 10: detailed documentation of sprint configuration/points/burndown, independent hands-on validation of the sprint workflow specifically.
